description: This file contains the PHP class 'searchCommands' which provides methods for searching and managing test cases, test suites, requirements, and related entities within the TestLink project. It handles initialization, database queries, and filtering operations specific to search functionalities in the TestLink testing platform.

classes.name: searchCommands
classes.description: A class that provides search functionality within the TestLink project, including methods for initializing environment, executing complex queries for test cases, requirements, test suites, and managing search parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database connection and managers, sets up database type-specific operators.

methods.name: isReqFeatureEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether requirement feature is enabled for a specific test project.

methods.name: getTestCaseIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves all test case IDs for a given project.

methods.name: getTestSuiteIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of test suites under a specific test project, considering exclusion filters.

methods.name: getReqSpecIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves all requirement specification IDs for a test project.

methods.name: getReqIDSet
methods.description: Retrieves all requirement IDs for a test project.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Returns the current search arguments.

methods.name: getGui
methods.description: Returns GUI configuration and state.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns current search filters.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns database tables involved in searches.

methods.name: getViews
methods.description: Returns database views involved in searches.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes search environment, including arguments, GUI, and search parameters.

methods.name: initSchema
methods.description: Initializes database schema elements such as tables and views.

methods.name: initArgs
methods.description: Initializes search arguments from request parameters and session data.

methods.name: initGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI state based on current arguments and configuration.

methods.name: initSearch
methods.description: Prepares search options, filters, linked custom fields, keywords, and status labels.

methods.name: searchReqSpec
methods.description: Searches requirement specifications based on target set and filters.

methods.name: searchReq
methods.description: Searches requirements with filtering on scope, status, type, author, and target set.

methods.name: searchTestSuites
methods.description: Searches test suites based on title and summary filters against target set.

methods.name: searchTestCases
methods.description: Performs complex search for test cases considering steps, expected results, keywords, custom fields, and target filters.

methods.name: getTestCaseWKFStatusDomain
methods.description: Returns a domain mapping of test case workflow statuses.
